description: This file defines the PendingAction class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard DTO namespace. The class represents a pending action summary related to human resource management, encapsulating an ActionSummary object and providing a method to generate a summary array if there are pending actions.

classes.name: PendingAction
classes.description: A DTO class representing a pending action summary within the dashboard, utilizing localization support via trait, encapsulating an ActionSummary object, and providing a method to generate a structured summary if pending actions exist.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PendingAction with an ActionSummary object.

methods.name: generateActionSummary
methods.description: Generates and returns an array with pending action details if the count is greater than zero; otherwise, returns null.
